title: panax japonicus var. major
intro: Panax japonicus var. major, commonly known as Asian ginseng or Taigi ginseng, is a plant species belonging to the Araliaceae family. It is a slow-growing perennial plant native to East Asia, known for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Panax japonicus var. major include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which help to reduce stress, improve mental clarity, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ginsenosides, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
